task.title: Configure your Python build tool to use the Lightwell Network repository
task.shortdesc: Configure your Python build tool to resolve dependencies through the Lightwell Network repository by adding the repository to your existing configuration.

Pipenv

substep.cmd: Run one of the following commands to add the Lightwell Network repository as the default source:

ol.li: Create and activate a virtual environment: $ python3.12 -m venv venv $ source venv/bin/activate
Install a package and confirm that it resolves through the Lightwell Network repository: $ pip install numpy
To install a specific version, specify the version number in the install command: $ pip install numpy==2.3.5

If you are using the Remediated repository, add a remediated dependency and verify that the resolved package version includes the .rhlw-0000X version suffix. If you are using the Predisclosure repository, add a remediated dependency and verify that the resolved package version includes the .rhlw-0000X-nXXXX version suffix. $ pip show numpy | grep Version
The output should show a version with the .rhlw-0000X or .rhlw-0000X-nXXXX suffix, for example, Version: 2.3.5.rhlw-00001.
